virals_narrative: Outside the watchlist, the last ~48h is a builder-vs-lab split. Labs still own the big numbers: theo's Gemini announcement gag (~354K), OpenAIDevs sweating the details (~227K), and Anthropic stacking a Claude Science UV sky map (~193K) with a Cyber Mission launch (~184K). On the builder side, theo's T3 Code run is the story of the window (zero-friction click, public annoyances page, encrypted-phone ssh comparison, feedback quality), with ThePrimeagen quoting along (~71K) and Garry Tan mixing GBrain (~45K), Seattle "no AI in the loop" (~31K), and ICs-with-agents productivity (~11K). Smaller AI-tool outsiders worth a glance: agents chatting with each other (~4K). For @bobbyships the cleanest angles today are a link-monitor receipt, a token-spend ROI screen, or a playable-in-browser follow-up to yesterday's Quake/WASM wave.
